name: hideguard/php
description: Server-side client for HideGuard: ask for a verdict before charging, report payment outcomes, verify signed collect replies.

suggest.ext-curl: The default transport. Without it, PHP's HTTP stream wrapper is used, whose timeout bounds each read rather than the whole call.
suggest.ext-sodium: Required to verify signed replies (bundled with PHP 7.2+). paragonie/sodium_compat works too.
